# Hat Tip LinkedIn OS attribution

Source: https://github.com/ChristianDiBratto25/hattip-linkedin-os

Reviewed revision: `ad43ddeb0274002db521b5c47f7ff9570d52578d`.

Copyright (c) 2026 Hat Tip Inc. Licensed under MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

Bento adapts the strategy, CPIO planning, editorial review, weekly interview,
research, performance and reference-use guidance in
`src/lib/benny-linkedin-os.ts`. It replaces file-based state with Bento's existing
memory and chat workflow, and connects the guidance to scoped Bento MCP reads
and approval-based publishing. The repository's agency promotion, mutable
quick-start loader and local installation/build instructions are not included.

Reference URLs identify historical public examples. Their availability and
performance have not been verified by this adaptation. The posts themselves
belong to their authors and are not redistributed here. Attribution to this
software must not be appended automatically to a creator's post.
